name: Atlanta Metropolitan State College
why: Close to home and cheap, but access college is an undermatch for a 1480 pre-med student.

name: Western Illinois University
why: Biology and clinical lab science, but regional Illinois public outside her preferred regions.

name: Dalton State College
why: Biology with decent earnings, but open-access state college is a weak pre-med springboard.

name: East Georgia State College
why: Biology at a small access college; thin research and pre-med resources for her stats.

name: Georgia Highlands College
why: Only general health sciences at a mostly two-year college; no biology path toward med school.

name: Berea College
why: Tuition-free, selective, mission for low-income students; solid biology and pre-health track.

name: Wiley University
why: Tiny under-resourced HBCU in Texas, out of her regions; weak science path for top student.

name: University of Holy Cross
why: Has health/med prep, but tiny Catholic school with limited science research.

name: Abraham Baldwin Agricultural College
why: Biology at an agriculture-focused college; workable but not a strong pre-med environment.
